name: wreck-it-ralph
description: Loop-engineered long-running agent harness: a living feature backlog, fresh-context coder -> verify gate -> tester sessions with locked examples, replay evidence and coverage gaps, parallel coders in git worktrees, distilled learnings, human escalation, run budgets, staged rollout, scheduled/CI triggers and issue intake. It composes with other plugins, supports presets for web/api/cli/library/data/docs plus brownfield projects, and includes an in-session Ralph loop with a real verify command.
